title: Make Susi Core say what is true after the 2026-11-22 decisions
goal: Vision: decisions of 2026-11-22, not yet recorded as a vision in this clone. Susi Core says what is true now: Susi is the private commercial product and the primary, Susi Core and Susi Tools are its public Apache-2.0 derivatives, and the three repositories move together on the local canonical Git server with hosted copies as write-only backups. Core has no line limit: its size is measured and reported, and the other pinned counts become baselines a change may raise in the same commit, saying why. Development-only code moves to Susi Tools (written down as not yet done). Agents can land a feature here from one page without being told to. The hosted-service guard covers GitLab, and the hooks call the development tool as its own program.

reuse.searched: This changes rules and removes a limit; it builds nothing new. Looked at what already holds each rule: AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/lean-core.md and the documents that repeat the limit; tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs, tests/architecture_tests.rs and tests/no_github_coupling.rs (extended in place, same matcher); .cargo/config.toml (the core-size alias keeps its name); .githooks (the existing run-susi lookup gains one program name; mandate-checks takes the same edit as the shared copy).

progress: 2026-11-22: this task's acceptance passes on Linux at core main f0dbfadfe (Susi Core's Linux gates ran the whole suite: 436 passed, none failed). It is not closed because `susi-tools tasks close` runs the acceptance on the machine that closes, and Susi Core does not build on Windows, where the tool runs; closing needs the tool on Linux (recorded in Susi's task T-CLAUDE-33).
